documents.title: Synthetic incident workflow
documents.text: The incident response team shortens outages by identifying faulty services rapidly. Correlating traces with application logs helps engineers pinpoint failures.

documents.title: Synthetic subscription policy
documents.text: A paid subscription can be cancelled at any time. A refund is available for the unused portion of the annual plan when a customer terminates their contract.

documents.title: Synthetic data location decision
documents.text: Customer records remain exclusively on servers located in Frankfurt, Germany. Information never leaves the European Union.

documents.title: Synthetic field inspection workflow
documents.text: Field technicians cache inspection forms on the device. They upload completed reports automatically when connectivity returns, allowing work to continue without reception.

documents.title: Synthetic inclusive interface requirements
documents.text: The interface supports screen readers and complete keyboard navigation. Every visual control includes a spoken label, and no action requires a mouse.

documents.title: Synthetic reporting feature
documents.text: Analysts can download comma-separated reports for spreadsheet applications. Each exported file includes the selected date range and account totals.

documents.title: Synthetic administrator security policy
documents.text: Administrator accounts must use multi-factor authentication. Signing in requires both a password and a one-time code generated by an authenticator application.

documents.title: Synthetic audit retention policy
documents.text: Audit events are erased after ninety days. The service automatically purges historical activity records when the retention period expires.
